items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: You know who else used to live on Prospect Avenue? Specs Powell, the drummer. He used to live on Prospect Avenue.

ctx.x: But you know something, one man if he had lived to get on television he would have been a natural, that was Fats Waller.
Oh, yeah, yeah! You know who else used to live on Prospect Avenue? Specs Powell, the drummer. He used to live on Prospect Avenue.
I know when I lived on 1218 Boston Road right after the Fat Man opened up, now I can tell you something. The original Fat Man was Charlie Turner, that's the one up on the hill.
